graph.num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph.
graph.num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the graph.
graph.vertices: <list[int], length num_vertices> Identifiers of all vertices in the graph.
graph.edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Pairs of vertices connected by an edge in the graph.

problem_settings.relaxed_clique_type: <str> Type of relaxed clique used for the decomposition (e.g., 's-plex').
problem_settings.parameter_s: <int> The s parameter controlling how many non-adjacencies each vertex in a group may have relative to the other members.
problem_settings.decomposition_type: <str> Whether the decomposition is a 'partitioning' (each vertex in exactly one group) or 'covering' (each vertex in at least one group).
problem_settings.connectivity_required: <bool> Whether each selected group must have a connected induced subgraph.
